definition_en: Valid votes received by each political party on the proportional-representation (समानुपातिक) ballot of a House of Representatives election, as published by the Election Commission of Nepal. Stored at national level and for each of the 77 districts; the district figures sum exactly to the national figure, which is checked on every load. Breakdown key: party — the party name EXACTLY as the Commission publishes it, in Devanagari, never transliterated by us. The time period is the calendar year of the election. Two elections are loaded: the House of Representatives election of 2082 BS, polled on 5 March 2026 (2082-11-21 BS), and that of 2079 BS, polled on 20 November 2022 (2079-08-04 BS). In 2079 two parties contested the proportional ballot under a single joint symbol and the Commission reports them as one combined row; it is stored as published and is not split. IMPORTANT: this is a count of ballots, not of voters — each voter also casts a separate first-past-the-post ballot — and it is NOT turnout, because the Commission publishes no registered-voter figure for these elections through this channel. Source: Election Commission of Nepal, result.election.gov.np, which describes its own figures as the consolidated count entered from counting centres; the certified record is held by the returning officers.

name_en: Seats won in the House of Representatives
definition_en: Seats won by each political party in a House of Representatives election, as published by the Election Commission of Nepal. Breakdown keys: party (Devanagari, exactly as published) and system. Only system='fptp' is loaded — the 165 first-past-the-post constituency seats — and the total is checked against 165 on every load. The 110 proportional seats are NOT loaded here: the Commission allocates them in a separate published notice rather than through the results portal, so loading them requires that document and a human review, which has not been done. A party's seat count under this indicator is therefore its constituency seats only, never its total in the 275-member house. The time period is the calendar year of the election: 2082 BS polled 5 March 2026, 2079 BS polled 20 November 2022. Source: Election Commission of Nepal, result.election.gov.np.

name_en: Votes for head of local government
definition_en: Votes received by each political party for the HEAD of a local government at Nepal's local election — the mayor (प्रमुख) of a municipality or the chair (अध्यक्ष) of a rural municipality — as published by the Election Commission of Nepal. Stored for each of Nepal's 753 local governments, so it answers "who won in my municipality". Breakdown keys: party (Devanagari, exactly as published) and elected ('yes' for the winning party's row, 'no' otherwise). Independents are published by the Commission under the party name स्वतन्त्र and are kept as published. The time period is the calendar year of polling: the local election of 2079 BS was polled on 2079-01-30 BS = Friday 13 May 2022, from the Commission's own sealed election programme. Only the head-of-government race is stored; deputy, ward-chair and member races are published per local body too but are not loaded. Candidates' personal details (name, age, gender, symbol) are deliberately NOT stored — only the result. Local-body identity comes from a curated code map built by matching the Commission's own English municipality name within the district, never by transliteration. Source: Election Commission of Nepal, result.election.gov.np.

Seats won by each political party at Nepal's local level (स्थानीय तह) election, as published by the Election Commission of Nepal. Breakdown keys: party (Devanagari, exactly as published) and post — the office contested, one of प्रमुख (mayor), अध्यक्ष (rural municipality chair), उपप्रमुख (deputy mayor), उपाध्यक्ष (deputy chair), वडा अध्यक्ष (ward chair), महिला सदस्य (woman member), दलित महिला सदस्य (Dalit woman member) and सदस्य (member). IMPORTANT LIMIT OF THE SOURCE: the Commission publishes only the four largest parties per office plus a combined अन्य (Other) row, so individual small parties and independents cannot be separated here — the totals are complete but the party detail is not. The time period is the calendar year of polling: the local election of 2079 BS was polled on 2079-01-30 BS = Friday 13 May 2022, a date taken from the Commission-sealed election programme published 2022-03-24 and converted with this project BS calendar, not assumed. Seats WON, which is not always the same as seats available: 123 दलित महिला सदस्य seats and 1 महिला सदस्य seat were not filled. Source: Election Commission of Nepal, result.election.gov.np.
